note: Layer 3. A project re-points --accent (and with it --focus-ring, which follows accent). --on-accent stays bg and --selected / --hover stay neutral in every project. The trading project also flips market direction. Rules are emitted into tokens.css as [data-project="<id>"] after the theme blocks.

tokens.name: brand-fleet
tokens.usage: Project layer, fleet-ade: the accent of the product. Default project.

tokens.name: brand-trade
tokens.usage: Project layer, trading review app (`data-project="trade"`): indigo accent. Not red or green, which belong to market direction.

tokens.name: brand-board
tokens.usage: Project layer, fleet dashboard (`data-project="board"`): teal accent.
